context:
Comparability check runs client-side after both DetailResult objects are
loaded. Returns a list of warnings; each warning renders as a dismissible
banner above the chart area.

Warning text should explain the implication, not just state the fact.
"Execution mode differs: sql vs dataframe" is insufficient - add
"results may not reflect platform SQL performance differences".
description:
The strategy doc (§ Trust, Visibility, and Ranking) lists the dimensions
on which two results are comparability-breaking. Phase 1 enforces
hard-blocks on benchmark and scale factor mismatch. Execution mode and
tuning mode are also comparability-breaking - a SQL vs DataFrame
comparison or a tuned vs notuning comparison can look like a platform
performance difference when it is actually a configuration difference.

Phase 1 couldn't enforce these because execution_mode and tuning_mode
weren't in the manifest. Once explorer-extend-manifest-and-pipeline
lands, the Compare view can inspect them and warn.

This TODO adds visible warnings (not hard-blocks) when:
  - The two results differ on execution_mode (SQL vs DataFrame)
  - The two results differ on tuning_mode (tuned vs notuning)
  - The two results use different query subsets (full vs partial)

Warnings are prominent (banner at top of compare view) but not blocking -
intentional cross-tuning comparisons are valuable.

anti_patterns.why: comparability is about methodology, trust is about provenance

anti_patterns.dont: hard-block on execution_mode or tuning_mode mismatch
anti_patterns.why: intentional cross-mode comparisons are valid analytical use cases

anti_patterns.instead: only warn when the dimension actually differs

preserves.behavior: Compare view still renders when warnings are present
Cross-tuning and cross-mode comparisons are allowed (not blocked) - warning is advisory, not preventive
Existing hard-block on benchmark mismatch and scale-factor mismatch - these remain blocking

work_units.notes:
Dimensions to check:
  - execution_mode: warn if "sql" vs "dataframe"
  - tuning_mode: warn if "tuned" vs "notuning"
  - query subset: warn if query_count differs and both are <full set
  - test_type: warn if "power" vs "throughput"

All are severity=warning (yellow banner), not error (red block).
work_units.summary: Add comparability check function to Compare.tsx: given two DetailResult objects, return a list of ComparabilityWarning records {dimension, value_a, value_b, severity}.
Render ComparabilityWarning banners above the compare chart: yellow background, icon + message per differing dimension. Dismissible.
Extend cohort validation in Compare.tsx: execution_mode + tuning_mode mismatches produce soft-warns; benchmark + scale mismatches remain hard-blocks.
